title: Facials for Dehydrated Skin in Dubai
h1: Dehydrated skin in Dubai: facials that can help
desc: Why air-conditioning and heat dehydrate skin in Dubai, and facials that help restore hydration: Oxygen Bomb Facial, HydraFacial and oxygen add-ons, with prices.
answer: Dubai's heat, sun and all-day air-conditioning pull water from the skin, leaving it tight, dull and more sensitive. Hydrating treatments such as the O2Derm Oxygen Bomb Facial (AED 350 + VAT) and HydraFacial (from AED 199 + VAT), with oxygen or LED add-ons, restore hydration quickly, while daily barrier care keeps it.
facts: Oxygen therapy, LED dome and mist
body:
## Dehydrated vs dry skin

Dry skin lacks oil and is a skin type. Dehydrated skin lacks water and can happen to any skin, even oily skin. Dehydration responds quickly to hydrating treatments and better daily care.

## Daily care

- A gentle, non-foaming cleanser
- Hyaluronic acid serum on damp skin
- A barrier-repair moisturiser with ceramides
- SPF 50 every day
- A humidifier at night if your AC runs

## Which facial

The Oxygen Bomb Facial is ideal for tight, sensitive or tired skin. HydraFacial adds exfoliation and extraction for dull or congested skin.
faq: How often should I have a hydrating facial?
Every 3 to 4 weeks keeps skin comfortable.
Is oxygen facial good for oily skin?
Yes; oily skin can still be dehydrated.
